ITEM 1 | Orange sliced carrot-like rounds and wedges, bright orange with slightly glossy, moist surface, cut into thick diagonal coins and half-moons about 2-3 cm across and 0.7 cm thick, arranged in a loose cluster on the left third of the plate, firm and holding shape | 110
ITEM 2 | Brown minced or shredded meat pieces, darker brown with browned edges and a slightly glossy sheen, irregular clumps about 1-2 cm, mixed with bits of pale golden crumbs and small green herb flecks, piled in a mound in the center-right of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Green chopped herb leaves, bright to dark green, finely chopped, scattered over and through the meat mound, covering a small area, slightly moist | 8
ITEM 4 | Red pepper pieces, bright red, thin strips about 0.5 cm wide and 2 cm long, scattered among the meat, slightly glossy, soft-looking | 6
ITEM 5 | Pale golden-yellow small pieces, possibly fine chopped aromatics, scattered within the meat mound, slightly translucent and moist, small amounts | 5
